description: This file contains a managed implementation of the MD5 hash algorithm used for cryptographic purposes within the PDFsharp library, specifically for scenarios where the standard .NET MD5 implementation is unavailable or incompatible with FIPS compliance.

classes.name: MD5Managed
classes.description: A custom managed implementation of the MD5 hash algorithm that extends HashAlgorithm, used for cryptographic hashing when the standard MD5 is insufficient or unavailable.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new MD5Managed object.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up internal state for a new hash computation.

methods.name: HashCore
methods.description: Processes input data in blocks, updating the hash state.

methods.name: HashFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation and returns the hash value.
